parameters.content:
## A1 Lead Intake + AI Qualifier
Every 5 min: read **CRM_Leads** rows with Status = Waiting (max 10 per run) → Gemini scores each message → spam/no-consent/invalid = **Error** row → Odoo `crm.lead` in company SunGuard: same email = **note on the existing lead**, else **new lead** (stage New, tags, stars, source Website) → sheet row **Processed** → Telegram for Hot/Warm.

Gemini busy (503): the row stays Waiting and is retried next run.
Odoo access: env vars ODOO_URL, ODOO_DB, ODOO_UID, ODOO_API_KEY (never stored in this workflow). IDs come from Odoo system parameter sunguard_crm.ids (made by odoo_setup_crm.py).
Settings → Error Workflow → **00 Error alert**.
